## Use from an MCP client instead of a shell
If your agent speaks MCP but can't run shell commands (Claude Desktop, chat clients), run the same testing engine as a stdio MCP s
Connections to servers under test stay open between tool calls, so agents can also observe notifications and session behavior that
one-shot CLI commands can't. See [MCPJam as an MCP server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/mcp-server.md).
* [MCPJam as an MCP server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/mcp-server.md): give MCP clients the testing engine over stdio
* [Migrating to CLI 4.0](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/migration.md): command-path and flag changes under `mcpjam cloud`
* [Full command reference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md): every flag for every command
